description:
Recorded at Ash Cave on 4-7-23. The Mouth of the cave is just to the right of the recorder, with the recorder pointed directly at the 90ft waterfall. Kit of pigeons is close by which you might hear if you listen closely. No human sound. 

Recorded on my Zoom H1n about 15 minutes after sunrise.
name: Ash Cave to my right - waterfall in front - woods to my left 720am on 4-7-23.wav
